name: RecurringExpenses

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: They suspect they are paying for services they rarely use

scenario_template.note: They discover several forgotten or rarely used subscriptions

scenario_template.topic: Disagreeing about which subscriptions are worth keeping
scenario_template.note: Each person has a favorite service they want to keep

scenario_template.topic: Creating a framework for evaluating recurring expenses
scenario_template.note: They ask how to compare cost against actual use

scenario_template.topic: Categorizing subscriptions as essential, useful, seasonal, or unnecessary
scenario_template.note: Assistant provides a simple decision framework

scenario_template.topic: Choosing which subscriptions to cancel or pause
scenario_template.note: They negotiate which services matter most

scenario_template.topic: Redirecting the savings toward another financial goal
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests assigning the freed-up money rather than letting it disappear into spending
They enjoy seeing immediate savings from small changes

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
